info.name: Tools Project - API Showcase
info.description:
A short student presentation collection: 31 requests, one test per request, covering all 22 versioned API/health endpoints. The original Package-Tracking collection remains the comprehensive test suite.

Setup: apply backend migrations with just goose-up, start the API, import this collection, then run the ENTIRE collection in order with one iteration. base_url defaults to http://localhost:8082. No environment file is needed; avoid environment variables overriding these collection variables. Seeded admin1 and courier1 @tracking.test use Assignment123!.

The first request generates a unique customer email and a delivery time 48 hours ahead. Login and creation requests save their tokens and IDs automatically. Each request has one small test for its expected status and main result. An unexpected HTTP status stops the runner. The shared cookie jar is disabled because the requests use bearer authentication.

The workflow creates three shipments, demonstrates delivery, customer cancellation, courier decline, and admin cancellation, inspects tracking/assignment history, then deletes only those three shipments. The newly registered customer remains because there is no user-deletion endpoint. A failed or interrupted run may leave its own shipments; use the saved IDs in the cleanup folder. Seeded inspection shipments are not changed.

Run the setup folders before sending later requests individually. Repeat status updates only in the supported order: pending -> picked_up -> in_transit -> delivered. The last request clears the locally saved tokens; server-issued bearer tokens expire normally.
